memory_candidates.content: To prove a post-commit completeness check RAN (rather than being silently skipped by an upstream filter that emptied its input list), do not assert the absence of skip-family warning strings -- that is via-negativa and weak. Instead plant a .git/hooks/pre-commit that reverts one target path inside the temporary partial index (git update-index --cacheinfo <pre-commit-blob-sha> <path>), so the path is dirty against HEAD after the commit. The check then exits non-zero naming that path if and only if it ran, giving a positive observable. This generalizes to any post-action verification gate whose clean path is silent.
